summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle on install
details: package.json declares "preinstall": "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (hex-mangled identifiers, string-lookup shim objects) and, at install time, downloads the Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, chmods it executable, and uses it to execFileSync an adjacent 727KB obfuscated JavaScript bundle (math_init.js) in the package directory. math_init.js uses a string-rotator and custom opcode-dispatch interpreter (VM-style obfuscation) — its actual behavior is opaque and not documented. Neither Bun nor math_init.js is referenced in the README or required by the package's advertised OREST Inputs CLI purpose. The alternate-runtime dispatch (executing the payload under Bun rather than Node) evades Node-focused install-time scanners; the obfuscation conceals what the payload does once it runs on the installer's host.
